use serde_json::json;
use tinystoragedrivers_core::{Precondition, Scope, StorageBackend};
use tinystoragedrivers_sqlite::SqliteStorage;

#[tokio::test]
async fn generate_be94_fixture() {
    let output = std::env::var("TSD_BE94_FIXTURE_OUT").expect("fixture output path");
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let db_path = dir.path().join("storage.db");
    let storage = SqliteStorage::open(&db_path).unwrap();
    let scoped = storage.for_scope(&Scope::local()).unwrap();
    scoped.documents().put("fixture", "document", json!({"source":"be94f75","value":42}), Precondition::None).await.unwrap();
    scoped.streams().append("fixture.events", json!({"source":"be94f75","sequence":1})).await.unwrap();
    scoped.blobs().put("fixture/blob", b"be94f75-preserved-blob".to_vec(), Some("text/plain")).await.unwrap();
    storage.native().with_connection(|conn| {
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO _tsd_scope_admissions(scope,generation,operation) VALUES ('local',7,'historic-reset')", [])?;
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO _tsd_purge_receipts(scope,operation,generation) VALUES ('local','historic-reset',7)", [])?;
        Ok(())
    }).await.unwrap();
    drop(scoped);
    drop(storage);
    std::fs::copy(db_path, output).unwrap();
}
